You're in a substance analysis lab. Therefore I would assume you have something to be analyzed. Obviously, I am brighter than I look.|Mali Errat and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>}}
A scientist and researcher, '''Mali Errat''' was an ancient [[Galacian]] of [[Gala]]. When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] were dispatched to Gala to mediate over the election of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda's]] successor, Kenobi enlisted Errat's help in determining if the Queen was being poisoned. Errat tested food served in the palace and determined that the Queen was poisoned by [[dimilatis]], an herb that grows in sea plains of Gala and had an antidote manufactured.
